title: Russia unveils new S-71K stealth missile for Su-57E amid potential sale to India
content: Russia has disclosed its latest S-71K Kovyor air-launched weapon designed specifically for the Su-57E fighter jet. This advanced system integrates the capabilities of both cruise missiles and drones, enabling effective stand-off attacks. With enhanced stealth features and cost-effectiveness for broader operational deployment, Russia is actively engaging India in discussions about potential joint production and technology transfer related to the Su-57E and its cutting-edge armaments.

title: Aadhaar Card global push: UIDAI working on access for NRIs and OCIs
content: Speaking during a fireside chat at Global Fintech Fest 2026, UIDAI CEO Saurabh Vijay said his objective is to build Aadhaar into a best-in-class digital identity infrastructure that can support its expansion internationally.

title: Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars
content: Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.

title: Women's Asia Cup: Sri Lanka fight back from 33/4 to beat Pakistan, set up India final
content: Sri Lanka emerged victorious in a dramatic four-wicket win against Pakistan during the Women's Asia Cup semi-final. Despite a rocky start, they rallied impressively to chase down the target. Fatima Sana, Pakistan's captain, delivered a commendable performance, yet her efforts fell short. This thrilling victory sets the stage for Sri Lanka to challenge India in the forthcoming tournament finale.

title: Tharoor answers Chidambaram’s questions on Brics benefits for India; BJP takes digs
content: Shashi Tharoor defended India's BRICS summit prestige in contrast to Chidambaram's questions on its tangible benefits. The BJP criticized Chidambaram's remarks and highlighted Tharoor's differing viewpoint. Tharoor stated hosting leaders shows diplomatic convening power and value. He also noted BRICS represents a majority of the world's population. Tharoor's independent views often create internal Congress party discussions.

title: Countries where you can buy iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cheaper than India
content: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models have officially launched worldwide.  These devices feature the powerful A20 Pro chip and improved camera technology.  Pricing for these flagship iPhones varies considerably across different countries.  The United States offers the most affordable purchase option for both models.  India's pricing reflects higher local taxes and import duties on electronics.

title: Pakistan mount stunning fightback, force tricky chase for England at Edgbaston
content: Day 3 of the third Test brought a thrilling turn of events as Pakistan demonstrated their resilience with a phenomenal 449 runs in their second innings, spanning nearly 97 overs. This left England with a target of just 130 runs to clinch the series. The highlight was a crucial 121-run partnership for the ninth wicket that stifled England's bowling attack, setting the stage for an exciting Day 4 showdown.

title: Max Thieriot turned 90-acre Sonoma ranch into vineyard, farm and retreat
content: Max Thieriot’s roughly 90-acre Sonoma County ranch has evolved since he and his wife Lexi bought it in 2013. The property now includes the nine-acre Bodega Thieriot Pinot noir vineyard, while the rest remains hillside, woodland and pasture. Though the actor’s family now lives in Washington state for most of the year, he continues returning to the ranch during the off-season.

title: Microsoft signs 'iron-clad' student privacy deal with teachers unions after NYC AI ban
content: Microsoft has signed a legally binding AI privacy agreement with the American Federation of Teachers and United Federation of Teachers, a week after Zohran Mamdani banned AI in NYC schools. The standard bars Microsoft from training AI on student data, tracking students or offering AI companion chatbots. School districts can cancel contracts over violations. Los Angeles Unified has paused student AI use, while unions want OpenAI and Anthropic to sign next.

title: Canada used recycled Christmas trees to restore Niagara River fish habitat
content: In an innovative approach, conservation teams are utilizing recycled Christmas trees to rejuvenate the coastal wetlands of Niagara River. This dynamic initiative, launched in 2016, spans over 1.64 kilometers, serving to calm wave action and lower erosion rates. By restoring vital aquatic habitats, the project aims to enhance the ecosystem, leading to a remarkable increase in both fish and shorebird populations alongside improved water quality.

title: Bigg Boss 20: Qazi Touqeer on his bond with Arijit Singh; ‘Woh Crazypan Ka Baap Hai'
content: Qazi Touqeer, a contestant on Bigg Boss, reminisced about his long-standing friendship with the talented singer Arijit Singh, whom he first met on a singing reality show two decades ago. With great admiration, Touqeer honored Singh's artistry by performing 'Tum Hi Ho' during a recent episode. In a heartwarming gesture, Arijit Singh revealed his intention to tune in to Bigg Boss exclusively to support Touqeer.

title: Houthi advances puts India and global trade closer to the edge
content: Houthi forces are close to seizing control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, crucial for global shipping. This advance heightens concerns over trade security and energy supply chains around the world. India could experience rising costs and extended transit times for its goods. The Houthis are also enhancing their military capabilities, including integrating AI into weapons systems. This development poses new geopolitical challenges, especially for Pakistan and its defense alliances.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ bold message: What did he say to hype Brittany Mahomes?
content: Patrick Mahomes has Chiefs fans buzzing ahead of Kansas City’s Week 1 clash with the Denver Broncos on September 14. Despite appearing on the injury report, Mahomes and Andy Reid have confirmed he will play without limitations. His latest Adidas Football campaign further raised excitement, prompting wife Brittany Mahomes to share an enthusiastic reaction. Mahomes has also credited Brittany and his family for supporting him during his recovery and offseason.

title: Leon Draisaitl and Celeste Desjardins’ fortune: How did they build it?

Celeste Desjardins, thriving in her acting career and brand endorsements, contributes to the duo's growing public profile. Since their marriage in France, their synergy has propelled both careers, marking a significant expansion of their impact and brand value together.

title: Instead of managing billions, Warren Buffett’s son Howard Buffett chose farming
content: Choosing a path less traveled, Howard Buffett, the son of Warren Buffett, dedicated his life to farming and conservation rather than finance. He skillfully managed farms in Nebraska and Illinois, prioritizing soil health. Warren Buffett supported his passion by purchasing a Nebraska farm for his son. As he transitions to the role of non-executive chairman at Berkshire Hathaway, Howard aims to safeguard the company’s culture following his father's legacy.

title: Mumbai mall entry case: Man used ChatGPT to create fake PMO docs, police tell court
content: A 24-year-old man was arrested for impersonating a PMO official at Jio World Plaza. He allegedly used ChatGPT to create fake PMO documents and an identity card. Police seized electronic devices and documents from his residence in Khar. His private security guard, an ex-Army personnel, was also arrested with a firearm. Both accused have been remanded to judicial custody by the court.

title: In Noida’s PG belt, buildings rise nine floors where two are allowed
content: Densely packed multi-storey paying guest accommodations have been built illegally in Noida villages. These structures often lack essential fire safety and emergency exits, posing significant risks. Many buildings violate building codes, with thin columns and narrow lanes hindering access for emergency services. Demand for affordable housing from students and IT professionals drives this rampant, unsafe construction. Tenants prioritize affordability over documented safety measures in their accommodation choices.

title: Lessons from Ukraine war: Poland wants its own Starlink; where does India stand?
content: Poland is set to collaborate with Finnish firm ICEYE to establish a new military satellite communications system, aiming to lessen its dependency on foreign entities for vital battlefield communications. This project is projected to unfold between 2026 and 2030, incorporating local industrial partners. Meanwhile, India has had robust military satellite communication capabilities for over ten years, recently enhancing its maritime surveillance with the launch of CMS-03.

title: 'We will never, ever forget': Trump commemorates 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
content: On the anniversary of 9/11, leaders across the United States honored the victims and reflected on the impact of the tragedy on current foreign policy. Speaking at the Pentagon, President Trump paid homage to the fallen and reaffirmed the nation’s determination, particularly in its dealings with Iran. Defense Secretary Hegseth reinforced this message, relating the historical attacks to the ongoing war on terror.

title: ‘His time will come’: Rahane wants Sooryavanshi to wait as Samson returns

In a recent video, Rahane encouraged young talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to trust in his instincts and play freely, while highlighting the need for mental resilience to bolster his career growth.

title: Days before 9/11, businessman took Twin Towers' lease; now, the rebuilding nears end
content: The final commercial office tower at the World Trade Center site is actively being built as the new global headquarters for American Express. This project has emerged after extensive planning and has navigated numerous hurdles. It acts as a tribute to the lives lost and rekindles commercial activity in Lower Manhattan, representing a crucial milestone in the comprehensive post-9/11 redevelopment plan.

title: UP man stalks, stabs teen in neck after she rejects his advances; arrested

The woman was rushed to a hospital for treatment of her wounds. Police apprehended the accused near the JCB Ground after receiving information. The sharp object used in the crime was reportedly thrown into a river.

title: 20 runs in 6 innings: Pak openers register worst Test series in 35 years vs England

This represented the team's worst performance in thirty-five years, with no partnership exceeding ten runs. Despite the collective shortcomings, Azan Awais managed to find some consistency, although his partners repeatedly fell victim to batting collapses, highlighted by a first innings disaster at Edgbaston.

He pointed out that these statistics illustrate the ongoing transformation of the global economic order. Furthermore, Putin and Prime Minister Modi participated in significant bilateral talks to strengthen ties.

He emphasized that film actors exude a certain style and presence in public. According to Roy, the popularity generated on social media doesn’t translate to real respect for actors. Ultimately, he feels that cinema will always be regarded as superior to television in terms of legacy.

This upswing comes on the heels of a notable rise in the previous week, primarily fueled by robust foreign currency assets. The central bank's proactive steps attracted more than USD 136 billion in fresh inflows. Conversely, there was a slight dip in the value of India's gold reserves during that period.

title: Nezam Hafiz faced Brian Lara in 1988; 13 years later, he lost his life in 9/11 attacks

After relocating to the U.S., he proudly represented the American cricket team. In his honor, teammates organized memorial cricket events in New York, which persisted for years following the September 11 tragedy. A bat used during these heartfelt matches now resides in a museum, serving as a poignant reminder of his legacy.

He pointed out that India's layered domestic system promotes talent depth, advocating for Pakistan to decentralise its cricket governance to enhance the game.

These planes are designed for survivability during national emergencies and conflicts.

title: Delhi 2047: The big plan, the bigger question
content: the master plan for Delhi 2047 (MPD-2047) was unveiled at the national media centre on august 20, 2026 . the plan is a framework for shaping the capital’s future growth . it has a focus spanning housing, mobility, infrastructure, environmental sustainability and efficient land use .

title: 35 dead, 54 missing after Philippines ferry fire; survivors recount desperate escape
content: a ferry fire broke out on the passenger ferry in the Philippines on friday night . the vessel was 7.4 kilometres off the village of Turda when the fire was reported . 43 survivors from the incident, according to the coast guard .

title: 'Will work with India, be friends': China ahead of PM Modi-Xi meeting in Delhi
